notes: School district, modified cash basis (first year after dissolved-district merger; beginning balances are zero and the 4,968,148.15 'Cash balance from dissolved district' is printed in total receipts but shown as a Special Item on the Statement of Activities, so it is recorded in adjustments; reported receipts total ties via includes_split). Receipts, disbursements and ending cash use the Governmental Funds (total) column after reclassifications on Exhibit D (p5); labels come from the fund statement on p4. The reclassification column eliminates 127,044.91 of transfers (116,000 general fund transfers out; 11,044.91 hidden inside the General Fund's Special education 0-5 program lines, transferred to the Cooperative Fund), so no transfers appear at the total level and transfers_in/out are null. 'Taxes: Other' 1,376,314.65 (p5) is split into property tax credit 1,330,183.74, homestead 26,476.85, pro-rate 8,913.97 and nameplate 10,740.09 using the General Fund (Exh. G p8: 1,353,519.45) and QCPU (Exh. M p15: 22,795.20) breakdowns. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position (p1); fund balance sheet on p3 not used. Detail: Exhibit G (General Fund budgetary comparison, program lines) plus Exhibits H, I, K, L, M, N, O. Exhibit P (object-level general fund disbursements, pp18-19, partial in trimmed PDF) and the General Fund Components combining schedule (pp6-7) duplicate those lines and were not recorded. In Exhibit G, 275,000 allocation to the Depreciation Fund is embedded in the student transportation - regular lines (shown by the Exhibit F reclassification, p7), so a contra expenditure line and an other-financing line were added; likewise the 11,044.91 General Fund to Cooperative Fund transfer inside the Special education 0-5 lines has a contra expenditure line and an other-financing line (Exhibit D p5, Cooperative Fund p16). The printed G disbursement total 5,254,317.95 includes that 275,000 and the 116,000 transfers. Student activity accounts (181,667.27 assigned fund balance) have no schedule in the trimmed PDF. Budget amounts of '-' recorded as 0; budget columns on other fund schedules are only totals, so budget_final null. Read pages 1-19 of 19. Recheck: 'Other student support' (Other Governmental Funds, p4) split into school nutrition 255,826.49 (Exh K) and student fee/activities residual 257,852.74; 'Other local receipts' split to show Cooperative Fund receipts from other districts 117,912.69 (Exh N) as intergovernmental.
